limitations_and_boundaries: The study focuses on a targeted screen of 24 TFs in BMDCs and 10 TFs in K562 cells; genome-wide scale is not yet demonstrated.
Genetic interaction analysis is limited to cells with multiple guides after strict filtering, and higher-order interactions remain challenging due to exponential scaling.
The model assumes linear effects and may not capture non-linear regulatory relationships.
Cell states are defined by clustering or PCA, which may not fully capture biological heterogeneity.
ChIP-seq validation is from bulk populations and may not reflect single-cell binding dynamics.

results.metric_name: Enrichment of bound TF targets in programs

provenance.text_excerpt: Genes bound by M1 TFs are enriched in P1 and P4 (positively regulated by M1); genes bound by the repressors Atf3 and Irf2 (M3) are enriched in P1 (negatively regulated by M3); genes bound by Atf3 are also enriched in P4 (including IL-6) (Gilchrist et al., 2006); Stat3- and Rela- (M2) bound genes are enriched in P4, and Cebpb bound genes are enriched in P5 (both positively regulated by M2). Bound targets of M4 TFs (Irf4, Runx1, Nfkb1) are enriched in P4, and Nfkb1 targets are also weakly enriched in its repressed target program P5.

results.value_raw_text: Genes bound by M1 TFs are enriched in P1 and P4; genes bound by repressors Atf3 and Irf2 (M3) are enriched in P1; Stat3- and Rela-bound genes enriched in P4; Cebpb-bound genes enriched in P5; M4 TF-bound genes enriched in P4.

claims.statement: Accounting for continuous cell states (PCA scores) improves detection of reproducible TF-specific effects.
